title: Drosophila Protein Z4 Possesses ZAD Dimerization Domain.
authors: Bonchuk, A N; Georgiev, P G
journal: Doklady biological sciences : proceedings of the Academy of Sciences of the USSR, Biological sciences sections
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过AlphaFold2建模和SAXS验证果蝇转录因子Z4的ZAD二聚化结构域，虽聚焦蛋白-蛋白二聚化而非TF-DNA结合，但涉及转录因子结构建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: The transcription factor Z4 (putzig) is one of the key proteins that determine the chromatin structure in Drosophila. Z4 is found at the boundaries of bands on polytene chromosomes, and the bands are currently thought to correlate with chromatin domains. Z4 is a component of a protein complex that additionally includes Chromator and BEAF-32, and a conserved domain is necessary to occur at the N end of Z4 to ensure its interaction with the two proteins. In this study, a zinc finger-associated domain (ZAD) domain was identified in Z4. The capability of dimerization was confirmed for the domain by biochemical methods. A dimer model of the domain was obtained using AlphaFold2, and the model structure was confirmed using small-angle X-ray scattering (SAXS). The dimer structure shows a fold typical of ZAD domains.
abstract_zh: 转录因子Z4（putzig）是决定果蝇（Drosophila）染色质结构的关键蛋白之一。Z4存在于多线染色体（polytene chromosomes）上的带（bands）边界处，而目前认为这些带与染色质结构域（chromatin domains）相关。Z4是一个蛋白复合物的组成部分，该复合物还包括Chromator和BEAF-32，并且Z4的N端存在一个保守结构域，该结构域对于其与这两种蛋白的相互作用是必需的。在本研究中，在Z4中鉴定出一个锌指相关结构域（zinc finger-associated domain, ZAD）。通过生物化学方法确认了该结构域的二聚化能力。利用AlphaFold2获得了该结构域的二聚体模型，并通过小角X射线散射（small-angle X-ray scattering, SAXS）确认了模型结构。二聚体结构显示出典型的ZAD结构域折叠方式。
